newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen stock rises as share offer closes.
newsitem.headline: Loewen stock rises as share offer closes.

text.p: Shares in The Loewen Group Inc climbed on Thursday amid signs of solid demand for a share offering from the funeral-home operator, analysts said.
Loewen's offering of 10 million shares, which can be increased by a 1.5 million share overallotment, was due to be priced Thursday evening and begin trading on Friday, underwriter Smith Barney said.
On the New York Stock Exchange, Loewen shares were up 1-1/8 to 33-1/8. The stock gained 1.15 to 45.40 on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

Analysts said investors responded positively to Loewen's message that the company has recovered from recent troubles, is poised for strong earnings growth and its share price is undervalued compared to its peers.
"They have been out marketing this issue and it looks like they have had success," said one analyst who asked not to be identified. "It should continue to rally short-term once they close the issue."
